title: Design System: Igor P. Ribeiro — Black & Red

display.purpose: Large opening statement; 38px at 850px and 34px at 480px.

motion.name: title-entrance
motion.purpose: 20px rise, reveal mask and brief 2px focus transition.

motion.name: project-entrance
motion.purpose: 34px rise and .98 scale; even cards delay 80ms.

motion.name: experience-entrance
motion.purpose: 24px rise with a shallow reveal mask.

motion.name: copy-entrance
motion.purpose: 26px rise. All items remain visible by default; reduced motion and keyboard focus cancel entrances.

motion.name: technology-icon-settle
motion.purpose: Once on group entry, 80ms stagger capped at 320ms. Separate pale icon surface; black Apple/Expo marks. Reduced motion disables it.

motion.name: pointer-follow
motion.purpose: Subtle red light behind content, fine pointers only; stops at rest, blur and pointer leave. Reduced motion suppresses it.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Filled action used on inner portfolio routes.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; padding:14px 20px; min-height:48px; box-sizing:border-box; border-radius:8px; background:#e62323; color:#000000; font-family:Geist,Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-button:hover { background:#be1515; color:#000000; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e62323; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Identity contact action
components.description: Pill action beside the identity row.
components.css: .ds-contact { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; padding:14px 20px; border-radius:24px; background:#e62323; color:#000000; font-family:Geist,Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-contact:hover { background:#be1515; color:#000000; } .ds-contact:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e62323; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Header navigation
components.description: Pale navigation controls with an underlined active route.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:4px; } .ds-nav a { padding:11px 16px; border-radius:24px; background:#111012; color:#ababab; font-family:Geist,Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:12px; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:5px; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color:#ededed; text-decoration:underline; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#e62323; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e62323; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Home project card
components.description: Tonal linked card with a title, description and compact stack.
components.html:
Technical project

Project description

React Native · TypeScript
components.css: .ds-project { display:block; padding:34px; border-radius:16px; background:#0d0d0d; color:#ededed; text-decoration:none; font-family:Geist,Archivo,sans-serif; transition:background .25s; } .ds-project:hover { background:#1a1a1a; color:#e62323; } .ds-project h3 { margin:0; font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:28px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.3; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-project p { margin:12px 0 0; color:#64545a; font-size:15px; line-height:1.75; } .ds-project span { display:block; margin-top:18px; color:#725e65; font-size:11px; line-height:1.7; } .ds-project:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e62323; outline-offset:5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-project { transition:none; } }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Red link used alongside primary actions and technical accounts.
components.html: Read more
components.css: .ds-text-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-top:20px; color:#e62323; font-family:Geist,Archivo,sans-serif; font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-text-link:hover { color:#e62323; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e62323; outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: Pure black ground with readable warm text, restrained red accents, native scrolling and a soft fine-pointer light. Technologies follow the summary with no square logo tiles. Further technology redesign awaits user ideas.
